description: This file contains generated C# code related to Orleans grain directory using Redis, including configuration options, options validator, and the implementation of Redis-based grain directory, as well as extension methods for integrating Redis grain directory into Orleans silos.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Redis grain directory, including connection configuration, creation function for Redis connection, and optional entry expiry.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, implementing configuration validation logic.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implementation of a grain directory using Redis for Orleans, supporting lookup, registration, unregistration, and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default method for creating a Redis connection multiplexer given the RedisGrainDirectoryOptions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Redis grain directory asynchronously.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Performs lookup of a grain address by GrainId.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle for initialization and cleanup.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, optionally replacing a previous address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a grain address from the directory.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Removes all addresses associated with specified silo addresses.
